# SERNET Financial Services

> SERNET Financial Services Pvt Ltd — NextGen Financial Service Network. 35+ years of trusted wealth management across 54 cities and 18 countries.

## About

SERNET Financial Services is a trusted wealth management company founded in 1989. We distribute financial products including stock trading, mutual fund investments, insurance, estate planning, credit counselling, and financial education. Operating across 54 cities in 18 countries, we serve retail individuals, HNW families, NRIs, and institutional clients with personalised financial planning.

## Products & Services

- **Trading**: Stock trading via Choice FinX, offered by Choice Equity Broking Pvt. Ltd. (SEBI-registered stock broker); SERNET is not a stock broker
- **Mutual Funds**: Regular-plan mutual fund investments via Tick Funds
- **Insurance**: Life, health, general and motor insurance through our IRDAI-registered broker partner, Shrigoda Insurance Brokers (SERNET is a referrer, not an insurer or broker)
- **Financial Education**: Investor awareness and literacy content
- **Estate Planning**: Will drafting, succession planning and trust services through partners
- **Credit Counselling**: Debt management and credit repair services

## Platforms

- [Choice FinX](https://choiceindia.com) — Trading and Demat account platform
- [TickFunds](https://tickfunds.sernetindia.com/login) — Mutual fund investment platform
- [Tushil](https://sernetindia.com/tushil) — Insurance platform
